translation: Whether both the arm and auxiliary bones are broken, or only one bone is broken, with stagnant blood congealing and pain, use manual technique to connect and align them correctly, apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏), wrap them in a bamboo curtain (竹簾), and bind them tightly with cloth strips. After three days open the curtain and look; press the affected place with the fingers, and if there is still something not level, knead and rub the congealed mass of stasis to restore it to its former state, change the applied plaster, and still wrap it in the bamboo curtain. Every morning take Zhenggu Zijin Dan (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹). <ins>Wanling Gao</ins> <ins>Zhenggu Zijin Dan</ins> (both seen in the injury of the vertex bone).
